thread.title_full: Jay Jones Suffers Major Blow in Polls - NewsBreak

author: Emily Prescott
title: Jay Jones Suffers Major Blow in Polls - NewsBreak
text:
By Emily Prescott ,
12 minutes ago Democratic candidate Jay Jones has faced significant backlash in Virginia’s Attorney General race after texts surfaced revealing Jones suggesting that former Virginia House Speaker Todd Gilbert deserve “two bullets to the head.” The messages, sent during Jones’s time as a delegate, have damaged his standing against Republican Attorney General Jason Miyares. Polls show Miyares leading by six points, and prediction markets suggest his reelection chances have increased since the messages surfaced.
Jones wrote, “Three people, two bullets Gilbert, hitler, and pol pot Gilbert gets two bullets to the head. Spoiler: put Gilbert in the crew with the two worst people you know and he receives both bullets every time.”
Miyares said, “Virginians are good and decent people, and they expect their leaders to carry themselves with civility, decorum, and integrity.” Miyares added, “Character is what you do in the dark when no one is watching. But now we know what he (Jones) was doing in the dark.”
Virginia Gov. Glenn Youngkin said, “This violent, disgusting rhetoric targeted at an elected official and his children is beyond disqualifying. Jay Jones said that ‘Gilbert gets two bullets to the head’ and then hoped his children would die. Read those words again.”
Youngkin added, “There is no ‘gosh, I’m sorry’ here. Jones doesn’t have the morality or character to drop out of this race, and his running mates Abigail Spanberger, Ghazala Hashmi, and every elected Democrat in Virginia don’t have the courage to call on him to step away from this campaign in disgrace.”
Jones has apologized, calling his comments unacceptable and expressing deep regret. Jones said, “I sincerely, from the bottom of my heart, want to express my remorse and my regret for what happened and what I said.” He added, “That language has no place in our discourse, and I am so remorseful for what happened.”
In their only debate, Miyares challenged Jones on the texts and a past reckless driving conviction. Jones claimed that Miyares is too aligned with Trump, stating, “Jason hangs out with Donald Trump at MAGA rallies.” He added, “I will see Jason Miyares and Donald Trump in court as your next attorney general.”
Democratic gubernatorial candidate Abigail Spanberger said, “After learning of these comments today, I spoke frankly with Jay about my disgust with what he had said and texted. I made clear to Jay that he must fully take responsibility for his words. What I have also made clear is that as a candidate—and as the next Governor over our Commonwealth, I will always condemn violent language in our politics.”
Emily Prescott covers U.S. politics & news for content partner Modern Newsstand LLC.
